recentChanges.summary: Swapped the Deploy Existing Assignments design versions: V1 is now the inline setup card → 'Pull & Apply' (modeless) flow and V2 is the setup-modal-popup → full-screen picker flow (previously the reverse). Done by exchanging the two branches in showVersion() so button labels still match; default boot lands on V1 (the card flow).

Fixed the V2 'Deploy Existing Assignments' design so it no longer shows V1's setup popup. Switching from V1 (whose setup modal auto-opens) to V2 left the V1 modal open over the V2 view; showVersion() now always dismisses the V1 modal before rendering, so V2 only ever uses its inline setup card.

Replaced the invented work-type options (Standard Shift / Training / On-Call) on the deployment work-type selects with the real CrewScheduler work types — Regular Time [REG], Comp Time [CT], Overtime [OT], Holiday [HOL] — matching the production fields and the naming used across the other Scheduling mocks. Feeds the main form's On-/Off-Duty selects and the V1/V2 setup selects.

In Preview Mode, the 'Add details — operational filters' drawer no longer pushes the preview ranking down when opened. It now floats as a purple dropdown layered on top of the ranking, anchored to its disclosure header (scrolls if it runs long). The full config-panel version is unchanged — only the compact preview-strip instance overlays.

Added a DESIGN V1/V2 version switcher for the Deploy Existing Assignments flow. V1: dates + work types + notes in a setup modal, then a full-screen assignment picker. V2: setup as a card with a 'Pull & Apply' button that collapses it to a summary strip and expands the picker to full width. Both reuse the existing assignment cards + Select Employee picker.

Moved Create New Deployment off the centered card to a full-width, two-column working layout: a full-width header band (title + deployment-type chooser side by side) over a grid of the form (left, in a bordered surface with two-up field rows) and a sticky live 'Deployment summary' rail (right). The rail recaps the deployment as it's built — color swatch, name/type, date range, location, on/off-duty work types, and a positions-filled progress bar — and updates live from the inputs, Flow A's qualifier cart, and Flow B's selected assignments + template. This fills the extra width with something useful so the screen no longer reads as empty.

Reworked the Create New Deployment form so it no longer feels bare: it now sits in a centered white card on the neutral page (was full-bleed white with inputs stretched to 1320px), grouped into labeled sections (Deployment details, Schedule, Work types, Notes) separated by hairline dividers, with two-up field rows (Name+Code, the two Work Type selects). Rebuilt the inline Create-Template builder to use the same 'shop into a cart' interaction as Flow A's 'Select qualifiers required to fill positions' — pick a qualifier from the dropdown to drop a position in, adjust counts with steppers, add no-qualifier open positions, and watch a live position preview on the right (replaces the old add-chip + number-field approach). Also forced input fields inside gray panels (qualifier columns, template panel) to render white for contrast.

Fixed the 'Select to deploy' flow on the Edit Assignments landing: the multi-select deploy bar was rendering as a tall dark column on the right because it sat as a flex sibling of the main content. It's now a floating bar fixed near the top, centered over the content area (offset past the sidenav), that fades/slides in when select mode is on — showing 'N selected', Cancel, and 'Deploy selected →'. Row checkboxes on deployable assignments are unchanged.

Demo polish: the prototype now opens straight into the Create New Deployment screen (Add New Deployment) instead of the Edit Assignments landing — flow-map deep links (incl. the 'land' node) are unchanged; removed the default pre-selection on the Flow B assignment cards so none start checked; and the shared Design Toolbox dock (comment + flow map) now stays hidden and only pops up on hover near the bottom-center.

Converted the Select Assignment(s) modal into an inline section of the Create New Deployment form (Flow B) — it now replaces the old 'Select Assignment(s)' button instead of opening an overlay. The search, deployable-assignment card grid, template area, and inline Create-Template panel render directly in the form; the live grid is the roster (no separate Save Roster step), and the section dims/blocks until start & end dates are set.

Closed the gaps against the Deploy Existing Assignment(s) PRD (SCHED-22431): (AC-7.8/7.9) multi-select assignments to deploy together via a 'Select to deploy' checkbox mode + sticky 'Deploy N selected' bar → date-pick → Select-existing flow with all pre-selected; (AC-7.6) single deploy now lives in a per-row ⋯ ellipses menu (Deploy/Edit/Delete) instead of a ⚡ button; (AC-5.1/6.2/6.3/6.5/US-21/26/27) Manage Templates page gained Create New Template + per-template Edit/Delete via a Template Editor dialog and a position-count/qualifier summary on each card; (AC-5.5) the template builders now take a primary + optional shared qualifier per position; (AC-1.3) tooltip on the Is Deployable? header; (AC-3.1) alphabetical sort of the assignment selection list. Templates are now a shared TEMPLATES list used by both the inline flow builder and the manage page. DEV-NOTES updated.

Built out the UX-review backlog for Deploy Existing Assignments: (1) Select Assignment(s) is now a near-full-screen ~85% working view (not a narrow modal) with a search box and a broad multi-column card grid; (2) the inline Create-Template builder now supports naming the template, adding qualified positions, and a count of open positions with no qualifier (minimum staffing / partial coverage); (3) new Manage Templates page (header button) listing deployable assignments + templates with a filter toggle and search, replacing the old multi-step flow; (4) Quick Deploy ⚡ action on deployable assignment rows that opens a date-pick dialog then drops into the Select-existing flow with that assignment pre-selected; and widened the Create New Deployment form. DEV-NOTES updated for all of these.

Existing-assignment flow (Flow B): the Create New Assignment Template flow is no longer a separate 'Select Qualifiers' modal — the qualifier picker is now an inline panel under 'Assignment Template(s)' inside the Select Assignment(s) modal, revealed by the '+ Create New Assignment Template' trigger (Cancel/Create inline; trigger hides while creating or once a template exists). Also: open slots in the deployment result on the form are now clickable and open the Select Employee people picker (flowB) to fill the position in place.

Flow Map node badges reworked: comment-widget comments now show as the prominent 💬 emoji badge in the node's top-right corner; dev annotations moved out of the corner to a purple glassmorphism badge (Font Awesome note icon) next to the step label. Removed the hover magnifying (node scale-up) on the map. Renamed the two multi-assignment branch nodes to their triggering action — Branch A 'Click an assignment' (clicking an open slot on any assignment, not a template, in the Select Assignment(s) modal → employee picker) and Branch B '+ Create New Assignment Template' (opens the Select Qualifiers dialog).

Toolbox: the comment-mode banner ('Click any element to leave feedback') now floats just above the bottom-center toolbox dock instead of top-right, and drops its redundant 'Esc to cancel' button — the docked Comments button already becomes ✕ Cancel in pick mode (Esc still works). Comment widget bumped to 1.16.1 (designtoolbox/feedback-widget.js change).

Toolbox: comment-widget button + Flow Map button now share one bottom-center 'version switcher' dock (window.ToolboxDock, defined in designtoolbox/toolbox.js) instead of a floating top-right bubble + separate pill — only affects mocks that load toolbox.js (deployment). Also replaced the Flow Map's localStorage dev annotations with read-only dev notes loaded from a committed DEV-NOTES.md next to the mock (shared via git, no longer per-browser); added deployment/DEV-NOTES.md with per-step developer handoff notes and made the flow-map drawer read-only with 📝 badge counts sourced from that file. Comment widget bumped to 1.16.0.

Moved the Flow Map launcher out of the bottom-right corner into a bottom-center version-switcher pill; on a single-version mock like deployment the switcher shows just the Flow Map button (shared designtoolbox/flow-map.js change).

Create New Deployment now starts with an empty qualifiers panel (removed the seeded FF/Capt/PM default; clears on every 'Add New Deployment'), and replaced the static start/end clock boxes with real vaadin-time-picker time inputs alongside the date pickers.

Renamed the toolbox folder to lowercase designtoolbox/ and updated every reference (12 mock embeds, widget internals, READMEs, the deployment loader include). Fixed a flow-map bug where the 'Flow Map' launcher button only mounted when the map was opened programmatically — it now mounts on page load, so the toolbox + flow map are fully applied to the deployment mock.

Consolidated the design tools into a single root designtoolbox/ folder (the comment widget — feedback-widget.js, log.html, worker/, scripts/ — plus the flow map: toolbox.js, flow-map.js, flow-thumbs/). Moved flow-thumbs out of deployment/. Repointed all comment-widget embeds across 12 mocks to ../../../designtoolbox/feedback-widget.js, updated the widget's internal log URL + inject script, and pointed the deployment loader at ../../../designtoolbox/toolbox.js. toolbox.js now loads both the widget and flow map relative to itself (also fixes an absolute-path bug that broke the comment-widget injection on GitHub Pages).

deployment.title: Deployments
deployment.description: End-to-end Deployments prototype imported from Figma. Starts on the Edit Assignments landing (production chrome); 'Add New Deployment' opens the full-page Create New Deployment form, which branches into Flow A (Create Deployment — interactive qualifiers panel + open-slot Select Employee picker) or Flow B (Select Existing Assignments — an inline Select Assignment(s) section with a searchable deployable-assignment card grid, slot bars, and an inline Create Assignment Template panel). Includes a 'Flow Map' dev tool: a branching map of every screen with an Edit Assignments entry node, hover-preview, and click-to-open-live deep-linking into both flows. Also includes a DESIGN V1/V2 version switcher (bottom-center pill) comparing two alternative 'Deploy Existing Assignments' designs: V1 collects dates/work types/notes in a setup modal, then a full-screen assignment picker pops up; V2 puts that setup in a card with a 'Pull & Apply' button that collapses the card to a summary strip and expands the assignment picker to full width.
